query: In summary, we implemented a proteo-genomic screening workflow, combining CRISPRa pooled cell surface libraries with a MACS enrichment strategy, in order to accelerate the identification of interactions between the secreted and membrane proteomes. We report new receptor-secreted ligand PPIs that are potentially involved in a wide variety of signaling processes. Implementation of cell-based screening strategies based on our approach might allow elucidation of receptor-ligand relationships for many proteins that are currently orphans, and has the potential to identify novel therapeutically relevant targets and define new biological processes.
